data_fields.name: hub service rows per town
data_fields.donor_constant: 12 rows (1 each for 9 service or story types, 3 cow rows)

data_fields.name: dead man presence gate
data_fields.donor_constant: present unless butcher quest is NOT_AVAILABLE or DONE

data_fields.name: gossip lines per NPC
data_fields.donor_constant: length of the row's gossip list, one chosen at random at spawn

data_fields.name: cow tiles per animal (comment only)
data_fields.donor_constant: 4 tiles for collision purposes (comment; code not read)

best_idea: Place hub services from a table in file order, skip rows whose presence gate is closed or whose behaviour is missing, and claim the tile before creating the NPC so multi-tile and neighbour logic can see it.
decision_why: The table-placed, gated, claim-first shape fits zones as data; the presence gate moves to the server ledger and is re-checked on zone entry, and duplicate tiles are rejected at load instead of overwritten.
acceptance: Walking into the town shows the smith, healer and tavern keeper on their zone-data tiles; closing a quest's gate removes its NPC on the next zone entry; a server test asserts a duplicate tile fails at load and a row with no behaviour is reported.
